findings.title: Possible hard-coded secret
findings.message: A credential-like value appears to be stored directly in source code.
findings.remediation: Move the value to an environment variable or secret manager, revoke the exposed value, and rotate it.

findings.title: Unsafe HTML assignment
findings.message: Writing arbitrary HTML can execute attacker-controlled scripts in the browser.
findings.remediation: Use textContent for plain text or sanitize trusted markup with a maintained allow-list sanitizer.

findings.title: SQL query built with string interpolation
findings.excerpt: return database.query(`SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '${name}'`);
findings.message: Building SQL with values embedded in a string can create a SQL injection vulnerability.
findings.remediation: Use parameterised queries or prepared statements and pass data separately from SQL text.

findings.title: Shell command execution
findings.message: Shell execution becomes dangerous when any argument can contain user-controlled data.
findings.remediation: Prefer execFile/spawn with a fixed executable and validated argument array; never concatenate untrusted input.

findings.title: Weak password hashing algorithm
findings.message: MD5 and SHA-1 are too fast and collision-prone for password storage.
findings.remediation: Use Argon2id, scrypt, or bcrypt with an appropriate work factor and a unique salt.

findings.title: Insecure HTTP endpoint
findings.message: Plain HTTP can expose data to interception or modification in transit.
findings.remediation: Use HTTPS and validate the remote certificate. Redirect public HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

findings.title: Debug mode enabled
findings.message: Debug mode may reveal stack traces, environment details, or privileged developer endpoints.
findings.remediation: Disable debug mode in deployed environments and keep detailed errors in protected logs.

findings.title: Sensitive data written to logs
findings.message: Logs may retain sensitive values longer than the application and expose them to more people.
findings.remediation: Remove the sensitive field or log only a redacted identifier with structured access controls.
